integrity: Two independent source implementations construct the entire metric-basis slide graph, compute all-pairs distances and compare the transport obstruction. These are same-model-reviewed, not independently audited.
scientific_limitations: Exact complete computation for the twelve-vertex icosahedral graph only; previous known metric dimension 3 is not claimed. Full reproducibility depends on inspecting and executing the embedded deterministic finite integer checkers. Historical priority for possibly unindexed computations is unconfirmed.
title: Antipodal matroid bases and one-slide transport detours on the icosahedron
